name: ColorSwatch
summary: A preview of one colour, read by a name made from its hue and lightness (Blue, dark; أزرق داكن), never by its hex alone. It draws an inner edge at 3:1 against the surface and a checkerboard under a see through colour. On web, ios and android it is the same square or disc; the platform only sets its size through the control tokens. It is content, not chrome: solid in every style, never glass.
useWhen: Showing a colour a person picked or saved: a label colour, a theme colour
The colour preview beside a hex field or in a list row
A legend key where the colour also has a name in text
avoidWhen: A status that must be told apart by colour alone

insteadUse.A status with a colour: StatusDot or Badge, which carry a word

color.description: The colour: a hex, rgb() or hsl() string, or a React Aria Color. Set inline as --_color-swatch-fill; it is the one raw colour, and it is data.

colorName.description: The name read for the colour. Default from colorName in @the-system/shared: the hue family and the shade, in the locale's language.

aria-label.description: Extra words read after the name, such as what the colour is for: Fill, لون الخلفية.

locale.description: The locale of the default name and the role word. Default the language of the nearest Theme.

size.description: The square: size.control xs, sm, md or lg.

shape.description: default: radius.xs. pill: a disc. square: no corner.

a11y.role: img with aria-roledescription colour swatch (عينة لون), named by the colour's name and then the aria-label.
a11y.focus: Not focusable. It is a picture of a value.

keys.Pointer: None. A swatch shows a colour; it takes no press and no drag.

a11y.announce: Blue, dark, colour swatch. A see through colour adds how see through it is: Blue, dark, 60% transparent. In Arabic: أزرق داكن، شفافية 60%، عينة لون.
notes: WCAG 2.2 1.1.1 and 1.4.1: the colour always has a text name. The default comes from the hue and the lightness in OKLCH, so similar colours get the same plain name.

WCAG 2.2 1.4.11: an inner edge in color.border.control, 3:1 or more against the surface in every style and scheme, so a swatch near the surface colour still shows where it ends. colorSwatchEdgeNeeded in @the-system/shared says when the colour alone would fail.
React Aria's own Arabic role word for a swatch reads تغيير الألوان (changing colours) and its Arabic names keep the English word order, so both are replaced.
Under forced colors the swatch keeps its colour (forced-color-adjust none) and the edge is CanvasText.

en.aria-label: Say what the colour is for, as a noun: Fill, Label colour. The colour's own name comes first and is automatic.
en.names: Hue family then shade: Blue, dark. Grey and colour are spelt the British way.

ar.aria-label: اسم بصيغة اسمية بدون تشكيل: لون الخلفية، لون التصنيف.
ar.names: اللون ثم الدرجة: أزرق داكن، أحمر فاتح. الأرقام لاتينية والفاصلة عربية.

react.behavior: React Aria ColorSwatch (react-aria-components) through its render prop; names and words from packages/shared/src/color.ts
react.note: No motion of its own. A parent's ring (ColorSwatchPicker) changes on duration.base; under reduced motion it changes at once.

angular.note: New wave 2: div[dsColorSwatch] with the same DOM and the same color.ts names.

native.note: Phase R5 draws it: a View with the colour as its fill, a hairline edge from the theme and accessibilityLabel from colorName.

styles.web: A rounded square of size.control.md with a 1px inner edge.
styles.ios: The same square or disc; the platform's control sizes make it larger. Content, so solid, never glass.
styles.android: The same, at the Material control sizes.
styles.studio: The same on the Studio tokens; no recipe.
styles.desk: The same on the Desk tokens; no recipe.
styles.neutral: The same on the Neutral tokens; no recipe.
styles.liquid: The same on the Liquid tokens; solid, as content stays solid.

mistakes.wrong: Naming a swatch by its hex code: #1E6FD9
mistakes.right: Let the default name read Blue, or pass colorName when the colour has a known name

mistakes.wrong: Writing the colour into a stylesheet
mistakes.right: Pass it as the color prop; it is data set as a custom property
